keyLimits.en: 1 user included, $29/mo per extra user; online booking, quotes, invoicing, online payments, basic reporting.
1 user included, $29/mo per extra user; adds automated reminders, automatic payments, checklists, QuickBooks sync, time/expense tracking.
1 user included (tiers up to 15 users at $499/mo), $29/mo per extra user; adds rich quote customization, job costing, two-way SMS, workflow automation.
5 users included (tiers up to 15 users at $699/mo), $29/mo per extra user; adds unlimited media storage, crew scheduling, custom reports, AI receptionist, dedicated support.

addOns.en: Extra users on any plan cost $29/mo each beyond the included seats.

cautions.en: Listed monthly prices carry a promotional annual discount of up to 40% (ending September 30, 2026); the non-discounted monthly price is what's recorded here.
Per-extra-user pricing ($29/mo) means a small crew quickly multiplies the base plan cost.

capabilities.en: Field service management: quoting, scheduling, invoicing and online payments for service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, cleaning, etc.).
Jobber AI assists with pricing, upsell suggestions and job time estimation; higher tiers add an AI receptionist.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; only a 14-day trial before a paid subscription is required.
Core plan (cheapest tier) lacks QuickBooks sync and automated reminders, available only from Connect upward.

unknowns: No alternativeCandidates for this slug's actual field-service-management competitors were present in the seed (the provided list is mostly unrelated productivity tools), so alternatives were left empty rather than guessed.
conflicts: Seed pricingText stated Core at $39/mo, but the official pricing page (accessed 2026-09-25) shows Core at $49/mo monthly / $21/mo annualized; the current official figure was used.
